blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Social Security System (SSS) will release P45.26 billion in 13th-month pensions to more than four million pensioners on Dec. 1 and 4. In a statement, SSS said it will release P25.33 billion to 2.39 million pensioners on Dec. 1, while the remaining P19.88 billion for 1.7 million pensioners will follow on Dec. 4. READ: SSS advances pension hike rollout to June as inflation relief step Meanwhile, P28.81 million will be disbursed to 3,798 pensioners with non-PESONet participating banks on Dec. 4.
